body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.89 (naive sector base rate 0.91) that: Lincoln Electric FY2026 adjusted operating income margin (company-reported) is >=17.7% (above FY2025's 17.6%). Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/US_INDUSTRIALS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.91 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=11); SAC -11.5 pts x weight 0.231 (N=6) -> p = 0.89. Evidence: Q4-2025 call (12-Feb-2026): 'a modest improvement in our operating margin for the full year'; reiterated Apr-2026. FY2025 adjusted operating income margin 17.6% (Q4-2025 release). Q1-2026 16.9%, Q3-2026 18.0%. Resolution: YES if the FY2026 adjusted operating income margin in Lincoln's Q4-2026 results release (8-K Item 2.02, Ex 99.1) is >= 17.7%, to one decimal. GAAP operating margin is NOT used. Source: Lincoln Electric Q4-2026 8-K Ex 99.1 press release (SEC EDGAR). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.91 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'margin', n=11); SAC -11.5 pts x weight 0.231 (N=6) -> p = 0.89
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'margin' promises among the other US industrials peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=11). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if the FY2026 adjusted operating income margin in Lincoln's Q4-2026 results release (8-K Item 2.02, Ex 99.1) is >= 17.7%, to one decimal. GAAP operating margin is NOT used.
data.resolution_source: Lincoln Electric Q4-2026 8-K Ex 99.1 press release (SEC EDGAR)

title: Paper call: Lincoln Electric FY2026 adjusted operating income margin (company-reported) is >=17.7% (above FY2025's 17.6%)
